# Desire Realty

> JDA & RERA approved real estate developer in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Specialises in residential plots, luxury apartments, and commercial/retail spaces. Operating since 2015.

## About

Desire Realty is a Jaipur-based real estate developer with 10+ years of experience, 10 completed projects, 1M+ sq.ft. delivered, and 500+ happy families. All projects are JDA approved and RERA registered (RAJ/A/2026/17214) and approved for home loans by SBI, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, and LIC Housing Finance.

- **Founded:** 2015
- **RERA Registration:** RAJ/A/2026/17214
- **Approvals:** JDA (Jaipur Development Authority) approved, RERA registered
- **Contact:** +91 86194 21661 | sales@desirerealty.in
- **Office:** 111/14, Sector-11, Kumbha Marg, Pratap Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302033
